name: AGC-035 -- Password Spray

techniques.comment: AGC-035: Password spray from COMPROMISED-HOST-01. 5 distinct target accounts (michael.chen, sarah.jenkins, raj.patel, james.wilson, admin.backup) tested with same password. Security EID 4625: 5 failed logons (Type 3, NTLM, Status 0xC000006D) from single source within 33 seconds. Sysmon EID 1: 11 net.exe executions with cleartext credentials in command line. Classic spray fingerprint: high account breadth, low per-account attempts. Verdict: True Positive, Confidence: High.
